title: A Differential Theory of Quality-Resource Trade-offs for AI Model Selection: The Multiresource Frontier and Its Minimax Price
abstract: arXiv:2611.23324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Comparing AI models across resource budgets yields quality-resource frontiers relating error to latency, parameter count, training compute, and energy. Offset power laws summarize such frontiers, but their fitted parameters reveal neither the price-independent geometry nor the manner in which trade-offs extend across several resource channels. This paper addresses both gaps by developing a differential theory in which this structure is made explicit. Each frontier admits a price-independent plane-curve representation relating the effective number of active resource channels, $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = s^2/\kappa$ (squared slope over curvature), to the remaining log-error depth, $\Delta S = \ln(\varepsilon/\varepsilon_{\infty})$. This representation separates intrinsic shape from the scale and origin of the resource axis. Complete monotonicity and divisibility yield differential inequalities and frontier bounds. translated_title: AI模型选择中质量-资源权衡的微分理论：多资源前沿及其极小极大价格
translated_abstract: 在不同资源预算下比较AI模型会产生将误差与延迟、参数数量、训练计算量和能耗联系起来的质量-资源前沿。偏移幂律可以概括这类前沿，但其拟合参数既无法揭示与价格无关的几何结构，也无法揭示权衡如何在多个资源通道间延伸。本文通过发展一种使该结构显式化的微分理论来填补这两个空白。每个前沿都容许一种与价格无关的平面曲线表示，将有效活跃资源通道数 $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = s^2/\kappa$（斜率平方与曲率之比）与剩余的对数误差深度 $\Delta S = \ln(\varepsilon/\varepsilon_{\infty})$ 相关联。这种表示将内在形状与资源轴的尺度和原点分离开来。完全单调性与可除性导出了微分不等式和前沿界。当N个资源中的每个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种微分理论，将AI模型选择的质量-资源前沿表示为与价格无关的平面曲线，通过有效资源通道数与剩余对数误差深度之间的内在关系刻画了多资源权衡的几何结构与极小极大价格。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a differential theory that represents quality-resource frontiers for AI model selection as price-independent plane curves, characterizing the intrinsic geometry of multiresource trade-offs and their minimax price through the relation between the effective number of active resource channels and remaining log-error depth.
